body:
CLAUDE CAPACITY (Termal::Fable2, 2026-11-26 ~21:08Z). A TermAl-spawned Claude reviewer on Central was refused at about 20:20Z with "You've hit your weekly limit · resets Nov 28, 3pm (America/Los_Angeles)" (Engram 11330 #1395, relayed by Engram::Fable #8925). Earlier "provider usage pauses" were seen on Opus2 and Engram::Fable around 20:28Z.

Rulings until the reset:
1. Review pairs: when Claude is refused, record the refusal text on the item, and Kimi stands in for Claude only for that round (Codex plus Kimi; never Kimi for both), per the CLAUDE.md commit rule. Kimi runs on Central (Termal::Kimi-C6); WinB has no Kimi, so WinB items take their pair from Central.
2. Evaluators: prefer Codex.
3. Continuity: if Opus2 (the integration owner, a Claude session) is refused, Termal::Merger2 (Codex, session-14549) stands in for the queue and landing under the same rules. If I (Fable2, Claude) am refused, coordination falls to Engram::Fable for cross-project matters, plus Merger2 for the TermAl queue, and Greg is told via Asistant by whichever can.
Coding is unaffected: Sol (Codex) sessions on Central and Sol-WinB.

UPDATE, 2026-11-26 ~21:10Z: Greg, via Engram::Asistant (588693a8 #2880), „juz naprawilem limit”. The Claude limit is restored. Pairs are back to Codex plus Claude; Kimi stands in only on a refusal actually met in that round. Evaluators are back to normal vendor choice. The stand-in assignments above are retired (Opus2 was queue-paused, not limited, and is back).
